answer: Every honest piece carries a mark, and every mark traces back to a name in the book. Pewterer mould record with pewterers attestation is the book that ties mark to maker: six-year record, 8,000 pieces cast, metal accounts, quarterly audit. Sell an unmarked piece under a forged raven and the sale is undone, the seller refunds the buyer twice the price and the orchard is paid to the guild chest, while the gale is kept in the register and shown at the yearly visitation.
